Nominal.description: Unscaled external rates without end-caps (2026-10-12, user decision): Z endcap backgrounds rejected via the SignalParticleSurface < 3 filter, as Truncated and Reduced; the external gamma and neutron rates are NOT divided by background_model_factors (no 4pi external reduction), as Pessimistic. No statistical reduction. Until 2026-10-12 Nominal kept the end-cap surfaces (fiducial Z cut) and divided the external rates by 12.57.

Reduced.description: Relaxed geometry. Z endcap backgrounds rejected via SignalParticleSurface < 3 filter (a quality cut, as the optical match); the Z fiducial cut is applied on top, as X and Y. Statistical reduction factor applied per component above reduction_threshold_mev. Represents shielding matching vd_1x8x14_3view_30deg_shielded: ~98% neutron reduction (all energies) and ~85% gamma reduction above 3.5 MeV. Background model: the external gamma and neutron rates are divided by background_model_factors (12.57 for HD and VD) at all energies; the Pessimistic folder keeps the unscaled rates.

Truncated.description: Truncated dataset. Z endcap backgrounds rejected via SignalParticleSurface < 3 filter (a quality cut, as the optical match); the Z fiducial cut is applied on top, as X and Y. No statistical reduction. Background model: the external gamma and neutron rates are divided by background_model_factors (12.57 for HD and VD) at all energies; the Pessimistic folder keeps the unscaled rates.

Pessimistic.description: Pessimistic background scenario: end-cap contributions retained, subject to the standard fiducial Z cut; external gamma and neutron rates are unscaled. No statistical reduction.
